panels.title: Retention Cohort Heatmap (D0–D7)
panels.description: Cohort-based retention: each cohort = users whose first activity was on a given date. Colour = % of cohort still active on day N.

targets.rawSql:
WITH recent AS (
  SELECT first_date AS cohort_date, user_id
  FROM cinema.user_first_seen FINAL
  WHERE $__dateFilter(first_date)
),
sizes AS (
  SELECT cohort_date, count() AS cohort_size FROM recent GROUP BY cohort_date
),
returns AS (
  SELECT r.cohort_date,
         toUInt8(dateDiff('day', r.cohort_date, s.event_date)) AS day_number,
         uniq(s.user_id) AS returned
  FROM recent AS r
  INNER JOIN cinema.daily_user_seen AS s ON s.user_id = r.user_id
  WHERE s.event_date BETWEEN r.cohort_date AND addDays(r.cohort_date, 7)
  GROUP BY cohort_date, day_number
),
pcts AS (
  SELECT returns.cohort_date, day_number,
         round(returned * 100.0 / nullIf(sizes.cohort_size, 0), 2) AS pct
  FROM returns INNER JOIN sizes ON sizes.cohort_date = returns.cohort_date
  WHERE day_number BETWEEN 0 AND 7
)
SELECT
  toStartOfDay(cohort_date) AS time,
  sumIf(pct, day_number = 0) AS D0,
  sumIf(pct, day_number = 1) AS D1,
  sumIf(pct, day_number = 2) AS D2,
  sumIf(pct, day_number = 3) AS D3,
  sumIf(pct, day_number = 4) AS D4,
  sumIf(pct, day_number = 5) AS D5,
  sumIf(pct, day_number = 6) AS D6,
  sumIf(pct, day_number = 7) AS D7
FROM pcts
GROUP BY cohort_date
ORDER BY time
SELECT sum(finished_count) / nullIf(sum(started_count), 0) AS conv FROM cinema.daily_user_activity WHERE $__dateFilter(event_date)
SELECT movie_id, sum(views) AS views FROM cinema.daily_movie_views WHERE $__dateFilter(event_date) GROUP BY movie_id ORDER BY views DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT sumIf(events, device_type='DESKTOP') AS Desktop, sumIf(events, device_type='MOBILE') AS Mobile, sumIf(events, device_type='TABLET') AS Tablet, sumIf(events, device_type='TV') AS TV FROM cinema.daily_device_distribution WHERE $__dateFilter(event_date)

SELECT toStartOfDay(event_date) AS t, 'started' AS metric, sum(started_count) AS value FROM cinema.daily_user_activity WHERE $__dateFilter(event_date) GROUP BY t UNION ALL SELECT toStartOfDay(event_date) AS t, 'finished' AS metric, sum(finished_count) AS value FROM cinema.daily_user_activity WHERE $__dateFilter(event_date) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t, metric
